about_the_game:
A joyful game of flow.

Experience the zen and skilful world of SPiNG. It's like a fidget spinner for your brain.

With one button control you can play flow through a sample of the 1000+ levels in the full game.

This is ~100 levels which represents < 10% of the game and gives a good sample of what to expect. This should take someone 1-2 hrs to complete.

There is also 3/7 themes to unlock.

You save game carries across to the full game also.

What's included:

  • Classic: 3/16 chapters: 55 / 288 levels

  • Rush: 1/20 chapters: 18 / 360 levels

  • One Chance 1/3 chapters: 18 / 54 levels

  • Lost Levels: 1/17 chapters: 18 / 301 levels

  • Daily Race: 1/3 Daily Modes

  • Zen mode: Just chill in this area

What's locked in the demo:

  • All the remaining chapters/levels from above 

    +

  • The Lab: 18 levels

  • One Life: How long can you last without dying and going through random levels

  • Hyper: classic: 288 levels at a faster pace

  • Play Perfect: 126 Levels that require precision

  • Endless: This is our score chasing mode using procedural levels

  • Hyper: Lab: 18 levels

Phew! that's a lot of stuff. Enjoy!
